items.name: Rocky board 6 x 10
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: FULL-BLEED top-down ground art for a cute creature-collecting tactical board. Paint only a quiet rocky FLOOR SURFACE, like very smooth weathered bedrock dusted with pale stone powder, not a landscape or scene. Straight orthographic overhead view, no perspective or horizon. Light desaturated warm-gray stone, centered around #d7d3cc with faint cooler-gray and taupe mottling. Muted low contrast, even diffuse illumination across the ENTIRE canvas, no focal lighting or edge darkening. Soft clean hand-painted cartoon game art, restrained broad flat color patches, no black outlines, no photoreal noise. At least90percent of the surface should be calm and visually open. A few TINY flat pebble flecks pressed completely flush into the floor are allowed, same value as surrounding ground, with no cast shadow or height. Keep flecks very sparse and smaller than one-tenth of a logical tile. No dense texture. This art is drawn BEHIND tiny40px-tall creatures, thin grid borders, purple dividing line, red/green boxes and colored targeting overlays, which must remain highly readable. Do NOT paint ANY of those overlays. Absolutely NO grid lines, square tile outlines, paving slabs, flagstones, straight seams, board divider, cracks that divide play spaces, labels, UI, creatures, props, vegetation, large rocks, boulders, piles of pebbles, cliffs, holes, pits, obstacles, terrain height, path, border, frame, vignette, rounded corners, transparency or margin. Flat non-obstructing surface only. Extend the same quiet rocky floor to all four edges.
Canvas: portrait1200x2000pixels, aspect3:5, equivalent to6columns by10rows with200x200px logical cells. This cell guide is INVISIBLE and MUST NOT be drawn. Any isolated pebble flecks should stay near the interior of imaginary cells rather than on their boundaries. Produce one single rectangular background image, no montage.
